usedFor: Hostfully holds bookings and inquiries, and Microsoft Excel receives a row for each through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Hostfully, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking lands as a row, giving you one running sheet of stays.

watchOut: “Updated Booking” in Hostfully repeats for a stay, so “Add Row To Table” duplicates it and “Update Row” fits better.
